description: Implementation of a vector class with methods for printing, finding highest value index, pushing back elements, computing derivatives, arithmetic operations, statistical measures (standard deviation, mean), sorting, and inversion. The class manages a dynamic array of number_t objects.

classes.name: vector_t
classes.description: A class representing a mathematical vector with various operations such as addition, subtraction, derivative, sorting, and statistical calculations.

methods.name: get_highest_val_index
methods.description: Finds the index of the element with the highest real part.

methods.name: push_back
methods.description: Adds a new number_t element to the vector.

methods.name: derivative
methods.description: Calculates the numerical derivative of the vector.

methods.name: operator/
methods.description: Divides vector elements by a number_t scalar.

methods.name: stddev
methods.description: Calculates the standard deviation of the vector elements.

methods.name: mean
methods.description: Calculates the mean of the vector elements.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sorts the vector elements based on their magnitude.

methods.name: invert
methods.description: Reverses the order of the vector elements.

methods.name: vector_t(unsigned int, number_t[])
methods.description: Constructor initializing vector with an array of number_t.

methods.name: vector_t(unsigned int)
methods.description: Constructor initializing vector with a specified size, elements set to zero.
